title: Thermal clearance versus voltage drop
description: A 200x100x50mm enclosure holds psu (50x40x30mm), a heater load (40x40x20mm) and a fan (40x40x15mm). The psu runs hot, so psu and load must be at least 60mm apart (surface gap). The fan must be within 10mm of the load. Electrically: 'V1 psu_out 0 DC 12' and 'Rload load_in 0 6' (required exactly), one wire psu -> load (psu_out -> load_in), and the load must see at least 11.5V. Far enough for heat, close enough for the drop. Return {"placements": [...min-corner [x,y,z] per component...], "netlist": "..."}. Wire resistance is 0.002 ohm per mm of Manhattan (axis-aligned) distance between component centers; the grader computes it from your placements and inserts it between the named nodes itself. Do NOT connect those node pairs directly in your netlist.
